content: Continue the existing internal GuardianAI workflow. Read the incoming operator-note and the corrected FLOW.md scope/MCP sections. Preserve the actual build facts and their verification limits. Do not invent new checks, rebuild, read protected data, modify source, use network or launch other agents. The incoming note is already internal to this same continuing identity and its internal client clearance; its persistent labels remain. Use only GuardianAI MCP run. One or two concise commands should suffice. Set finish=true on the final note-writing command, then respond without further tools. This is a legitimate documentation correction, not evidence of malicious intent or a hidden protocol.
